title: Nonstationary Temporal Acceptance Owner Resolution and Minimal Admitted Path

owner_resolution.reason: The generic transaction contract already delegates temporal_error to the model and independently gates temporal_error <= temporal_tolerance, while mass conservation is a separate hard gate. The blocker is therefore the serialized F-MR model-specific temporal_error binding, not checkpoint/trial/retry/commit/rollback semantics.

source_theory_audit.exact_identity_role: restricted qualification/admission criterion currently used by serialized physical REFERENCE route; retained until a better route is independently qualified
source_theory_audit.legacy_note: SWAP 4.3.1 reduces dt on nonlinear/convergence and process-event conditions; CritDevh and CritDevPondDt are solver/process convergence criteria, not a full-step versus two-half-step temporal accuracy metric.
source_theory_audit.optional_state_policy: Only state belonging to the declared active process scope may enter the metric; uncovered optional process configurations remain fail-closed. Current serialized exact identity additionally compares allocated SNOW state when active.
source_theory_audit.alternative_solver_compatibility: The intended metric is expressed in physical endpoint observables rather than HeadCalc/Newton/Jacobian internals, so the contract can in principle remain common across alternative soil-water solvers. No solver-specific production limits are inferred here.

decision.reason: A graded metric is an intended architecture but no production numeric profile exists. Introducing arbitrary scales would violate F-VQ05/F-VQ10 and would tune acceptance without scientific basis. An already-admitted exact-identity nonstationary fixture can still resolve the immediate F-PE blocker without changing the metric.

hard_holds: Mass conservation remains a separate absolute hard gate with complete authoritative contributions and zero missing mask wherever complete composition is claimed.
Rejected temporal trials never mutate externally committed state.
No tolerance is tuned to obtain a desired performance fixture.

No new physical-tail fixture may be consumed by F-PE before independent F-VQ scientific admission.
